Node.description: One visible/semantic node exported by the capture producer.

bounds.description: x,y,width,height in capture pixels; omitted when unavailable.

disclosure.description: Explicit disclosure/footnote declaration from the source producer.

id.description: Stable source ID, never matched by approximate text.

keyboard_order.description: Producer keyboard traversal ordinal; omitted for nonfocusable nodes.

ocr_confidence.description: OCR confidence, retained as observation rather than probability/proof.

reading_order.description: Authoritative producer reading ordinal; never geometric top-to-bottom order.

role.description: Producer-declared role, not an OCR inference.

text.description: Exact Unicode content; prices and identifiers are not normalized.

description: Capture-bound producer text and layout facts.

capture_sha256.description: Exact screenshot file SHA-256 (64 lowercase hex, like DOM region metadata).

complete.description: True only if the producer declares complete captured source scope.

kind.description: dom, accessibility_tree, or tesseract_tsv. Never inferred from image geometry.

nodes.description: Stable producer IDs for DOM/AX; OCR IDs name geometric word slots only.

producer.description: Producer/version, or pinned OCR executable/model hashes and settings.

title: Source
